title: Rune Technologies Joins Team Anduril for their Next Generation Command and Control (NGC2) Prototype for the U.S. ArmY | Rune Technologies News
summary: Rune Technologies awarded $2M for predictive logistics platform.
body_markdown:
# $2 Million Army Award


Rune Technologies is thrilled to announce that it has been awarded a $2 million contract by the Army to further develop its predictive logistics platform. This funding will enable the company to enhance its capabilities in delivering timely and efficient logistics solutions.


> "This award underscores the Army's commitment to innovation in logistics," said a Rune Technologies official.


The predictive logistics platform aims to optimize supply chain management and improve resource allocation for military operations.
